# vue-vrm

> Vrm viewer component for Vue 3.

## Guide

- [Introduction](/vue-vrm/guide/start/introduction.md): Introduction to Rspress features, including build performance, AI-native output, MDX, and extensibility.
- [Getting started](/vue-vrm/guide/start/getting-started.md): Set up an Rspress project, run local development, build production output, and choose next docs topics.
- [MDX & React components](/vue-vrm/guide/use-mdx/components.md): Use Markdown, MDX, React components, and Rspress built-in components in documentation pages.
- [Code blocks](/vue-vrm/guide/use-mdx/code-blocks/index.md): Configure Rspress code blocks with Shiki syntax highlighting and automatic language handling.
- [Title](/vue-vrm/guide/use-mdx/code-blocks/title.md): Add file titles to Rspress code blocks using Markdown code fence metadata.
- [Meta](/vue-vrm/guide/use-mdx/code-blocks/meta.md): Add metadata such as line numbers, wrapping, and titles to Rspress code blocks.
- [Container](/vue-vrm/guide/use-mdx/container.md): Create Rspress custom containers for tips, info, warnings, dangers, details, and custom titles.

## API

- [API Overview](/vue-vrm/api/index.md): Overview page for the Rspress starter API section and available reference pages.
- [Commands](/vue-vrm/api/commands.md): Command reference for Rspress development, production build, and local preview scripts.

## Playground

- [Demo](/vue-vrm/playground.md): Live demo.
